JSON Schema is part of 3 of my public repositories, from 2025 to 2026.

What it was for: [Tools](@/projects/tools.md) (2) and [Media and art](@/projects/media.md) (1).

Most recently: [Sonic Playground](@/work/sonic-playground.md): A hand-picked music blog built with Phoenix and Elixir on the Kita theme; [vomaste.cz](@/work/vomaste-cz.md); [comtesse](@/work/comtesse.md).

2 of these projects run as live sites.

How to read the evidence: every [repository](@/glossary/repository.md) below is measured from GitHub and GitLab (every 6 hours) and says how it uses JSON Schema: as the main language, as a measured share of its code, in its declared stack or as a topic. The reference graph links JSON Schema to the repositories and to the other languages and technologies they use together.
